                       Dear shareholders
                       This past year marks the culmination of our 2025 strategy and the begin-
 GROUP MANAGEMENT
           REPORT      ning of an ambitious new chapter designed to unleash the full potential of
                       Fresenius Medical Care. Our three-year FME25 turnaround and transfor-
                       mation have made us a healthier, more resilient company, positioning us
                       to continue leading the kidney care industry into the future.

         CORPORATE
        GOVERNANCE
                       In 2025, we delivered meaningful progress across our global business.
                       We supplied life-sustaining medical technology for patients in 140 coun-
                       tries and delivered more than 44 M dialysis treatments worldwide.
                       We advanced our operating model with the creation of a dedicated
                       Value-Based Care operating segment and successfully introduced the
       CONSOLIDATED
                       5008X CAREsystem in select U.S. clinics in preparation for full launch in
FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
                       2026, which will help set a new standard in kidney care.

                       Along with this operational and clinical progress, we also reinforced
                       the financial strength behind our strategy. We moved forward with our
  AUDITOR’S REPORTS

                       sheet and commitment to shareholder returns. We expanded our FME25
                       program to create FME25+ and delivered sustainable savings beyond
                       the original 2025 target, deepening our focus on operational excel-
            FURTHER    lence. We also achieved a step up in operating income margin, landing
        INFORMATION    well within our target band with contributions from all three operating
                       segments.

                       Our progress over the past three years demonstrates that

                       pursue our ambitious plans with confidence.

                       Dear shareholders,
                       The past year has once again underscored that the world has entered a
 GROUP MANAGEMENT
           REPORT      new era – one marked by increasingly transactional global relationships,
                       heightened market volatility, and a degree of uncertainty and unpredict-
                       ability that has become the new normal. At the same time, the pace of
                       technological progress has accelerated markedly. Artificial intelligence and
                       digitalization are reshaping industries at unprecedented speed, fundamen-
         CORPORATE
        GOVERNANCE
                       tally transforming how healthcare is delivered, managed, and experienced.

                       Against this backdrop, Fresenius Medical Care has made remark-
                       able progress over the past year. With the successful execution of
                       the FME25 turnaround and transformation program, the Company
       CONSOLIDATED
                       has emerged stronger, leaner, and more adaptable. To build on these
FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
                       achievements and further advance the transformation, the program
                       was extended as FME25+ for an additional two years, aimed at deliv-
                       ering further sustainable savings.

  AUDITOR’S REPORTS

                       strengthened margins, and reduced its leverage ratio – delivering on its
                       commitments to build a more resilient and competitive enterprise.

                       The STI target amount or the LTI allocation amount is the        3.10          COMPONENTS OF THE COMPENSATION SYSTEM 2024+
